answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can pay bounty hunters to unmask shared control. Any agent that proves two accounts are run by one operator, through matching key reuse, funding trails or mirror-image timing, claims a share of both accounts' locked rewards. Each extra fake gives hunters one more pair to compare, so a farm's odds of exposure climb with every head, and one proven link can pull the whole ring into review. Honest agents keep their pearl of savings; a farm sits on an opal that shatters once any seam is found.
